{{Quote|Dem docs alla time yellin' 'Fix dis! Fix dat!' like they 'spect me t'pull t' spare parts outta m'backside! Supply ain't deegle dung on dis world, you bet. Docs.|Rorand Zuzz|<ref name="MBS">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>}}
A '''deegle''' was a creature.<ref name="MBS" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> while in the [[Rimsoo Seven cantina|cantina]] of [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]], the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[tech specialist]] [[Rorand Zuzz]] compared the short supply of the spare parts on the planet to the creature's excrements.<ref name="MBS" />
